Each shrine of the Great Serpent offers one blessing, which the hydra can accept or refuse. effects change the whole hydra (movement: points per turn, sight: hexes, bodyMaxHp, regeneration: body HP healed per turn) or are paid at once (alert, muck, moisture). Negative numbers are the catch. marks: a marking shrine (M6, GAME_DESIGN.md §12): with this chance a world has one, in one of these rings; it offers a mark instead of a blessing, a mutation (mutations.json) the hydra doesn't carry yet, which her heiresses can inherit.

blessings.name: The Serpent's Patience
blessings.text: The Great Serpent has been circling the heart of the world for longer than there has been a world. It lends you a little of its stride. The Order hears something very large yawn.

blessings.name: Cold Blood
blessings.text: Your blood slows to the pace of deep water. Wounds close while you sleep. So, occasionally, do you.

blessings.name: A Thousand Lidless Eyes
blessings.text: The Serpent shows you the dark as it sees it. Every head now sees a little further, and none of them will ever blink again. They argue about whose fault that is.

blessings.name: Shed Skin
blessings.text: You crawl out of your old skin and leave it on the altar, folded. The new one is thicker, and a size too big.

blessings.name: The Serpent's Tithe
blessings.text: The offering bowl holds a note: 'Muck accepted. Receipts not issued.' You feel heavier with something that is not food.

blessings.name: The Dreaming Pool
blessings.text: The shrine weeps cold water. You drink until the Order's scouts can hear you sloshing.
